# nebulex_streams v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

Real-time event streaming for Nebulex caches

## Modules

- [Nebulex.Streams](https://nebulex-streams.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Streams.md): Real-time event streaming for Nebulex caches.
- [Nebulex.Streams.Invalidator](https://nebulex-streams.hexdocs.pm/Nebulex.Streams.Invalidator.md): Automatic cache invalidation for distributed Nebulex caches.
